title: Data Structures & Algorithms Assignment 3
subject: Data Structures
description: Implement Binary Search Trees, AVL Trees, and Graph Traversal algorithms (BFS / DFS) in Java or C++. Submit a zipped source folder with a README explaining your approach.
instructions: Use only standard libraries. Code must compile without errors. Include at least 3 test cases per data structure.

title: Database Systems Mini Project
subject: Database Systems
description: Design a complete ER Diagram and implement SQL DDL + DML queries for a University Management Portal. Include at least 6 tables with proper constraints and foreign keys.
instructions: Submit a PDF containing your ER diagram, all SQL scripts, and a 1-page reflection. Scripts must be runnable in MySQL 8.

title: Computer Networks Lab Report 4
subject: Computer Networks
description: Wireshark packet capture analysis: identify TCP handshake, analyse HTTP headers, and compare UDP vs TCP behaviour under simulated packet loss.
instructions: Include at least 5 annotated screenshots from Wireshark. Explain each observation in 2-3 sentences. Submit as a single PDF.

title: Software Engineering Case Study
subject: Software Engineering
description: Agile Scrum Sprint Planning for an E-Commerce application. Prepare a product backlog, sprint backlog, user stories, and a 2-week burndown chart.
instructions: Use the Agile Scrum template provided. Each user story must have acceptance criteria. Include a retrospective section.
feedback: Excellent sprint backlog division and burndown chart design. Acceptance criteria were clearly written. Great work overall!

title: Operating Systems Process Scheduling Report
subject: Operating Systems
description: Compare CPU scheduling algorithms: FCFS, SJF, Round Robin, and Priority Scheduling. Simulate each algorithm with the given process table and calculate average waiting time and turnaround time.
instructions: Show all calculations step-by-step using Gantt charts. Implement at least one algorithm in C and attach the source code.

title: Machine Learning Mini Assignment – Linear Regression
subject: Machine Learning
description: Implement Linear Regression from scratch using Python and NumPy (no sklearn). Train on the provided housing dataset and plot the cost function convergence over 1000 iterations.
instructions: Submit a Jupyter Notebook (.ipynb) with all cells executed and output visible. Include a brief explanation of each step as markdown cells.
